name: Say No to Rom-Coms!
source:
When your attempt to ask out your crush is met with rejection, your classmate Mineko, who recently experienced similar heartbreak, ropes you into joining her visionary anti-romance club. Together, you form a movement to challenge the expectations of teenage romance and ideals, aka the hierarchy of hotness, that Mineko believes students use to determine if someone is worth dating or not. But things take an unexpected turn when she decides to run for student council president—the same position as the crush who rejected you—with the goal of destroying the hierarchy of hotness that plagues your school!

Make a stand against heartbreak—say No to Rom-Coms, and join the Anti-Romance Movement today!
translation:
当你试图约你暗恋的人却遭到拒绝时，你的同学峰子最近也经历过类似的心碎，她拉着你加入她富有远见的反浪漫俱乐部。你们一起发起一场运动，挑战青少年对浪漫和理想的期望，也就是性感等级，Mineko认为学生用它来确定某人是否值得约会。但当她决定竞选学生会主席时，事情发生了意想不到的转变——与拒绝你的暗恋者的职位相同——目标是摧毁困扰你学校的性感等级制度！

坚决反对心碎——向浪漫喜剧说“不”，立即加入反浪漫运动！
